title: Telegram Desktop session and cache (Snap)
whyItMatters: The Snap build keeps the live Telegram session and media cache under the user's snap folder, where a native-only check will not find it.
source: Snap keeps per-app data under ~/snap/<name>/common; Telegram Desktop's snap is telegram-desktop: https://snapcraft.io/telegram-desktop
notes: common is a real folder shared across revisions, so the path stays stable after updates. Settings saved outside the sandbox may live in ~/snap/telegram-desktop/current/.config instead.
